description: Three-phase averaged power stage: converts duties (du/dv/dw percent, SVPWM convention) at the DC link into phase-to-neutral-mid voltages with the IGBT knee, deadtime distortion and Rce drop. Sign error convention sign(i)*(v_ce0 + td*f_sw*vdc + r_ce*|i_p|).

inputPorts.name: Du
inputPorts.description: Phase U duty, percent (0-100, 50 = zero vector).

inputPorts.name: I_U
inputPorts.description: Phase current, A (for sign distortion; from machine output).

inputPorts.name: OpenGates
inputPorts.description: >=0.5: power stage de-energized, all phase voltage outputs go to zero (leg nodes float; the twin's phase-ADC convention).

outputPorts.name: V_U_Raw
outputPorts.description: Pre-distortion duty-mapped phase voltage, V (the MAX22530 phase-sense view; knee/deadtime/Rce error is invisible to that ADC).

Rce_Ohm.description: Effective series resistance per device path incl. lead, ohm.

TdOverhead.description: Dimensionless deadtime distortion factor: dt_dead * f_sw (e.g. 1e-6*5000 = 0.005).
